subject: Gratitude, Sunshine & Coastal Gatherings
preheader: Turkey Trot, world-class tennis and the 100-foot tree: what's ahead in Delray Beach.
headline: Gratitude Feels Different by the Ocean
body: As November settles in, Delray Beach shows its softer side. The days are warm and breezy, the ocean takes on a golden late-autumn light, and downtown fills with reasons to get together: a Thanksgiving-week 5K along the beach, international tennis at the Delray Beach Tennis Center, and Small Business Saturday on the Avenue.
Discover Casa Avenida, a boutique collection of eight luxury townhome-style residences near Atlantic Avenue, and imagine making this season in Delray part of your everyday.

events.title: 40th Annual Delray Beach Turkey Trot 5K
events.desc: A Thanksgiving-week 5K run or walk along the oceanfront, 6:30–9 AM, starting at Anchor Park.

events.title: Billie Jean King Cup: USA vs. Hungary
events.desc: Two days of international women’s tennis at the Delray Beach Tennis Center. Gates open at noon, first match at 1:30 PM.

events.title: Shop Small Sidewalk Sale
events.desc: Small Business Saturday downtown, 11 AM–6 PM, with sidewalk deals at independent shops and the launch of the Holiday Rewards Pass.

events.title: 100-Foot Christmas Tree Lighting & Yuletide Festival
events.desc: Old School Square, 6–9 PM. The tree is lit at 7 PM, followed by a holiday street festival on Atlantic Avenue.

events.title: 26th Annual Downtown Delray Beach Art Festival
events.desc: A free, juried outdoor show with more than 100 artists on NE 4th Avenue, 10 AM–5 PM both days.

events.title: Holiday Boat Parade
events.desc: Decorated boats travel the Intracoastal from Lantana south to Delray Beach, 6–9 PM, reaching the Atlantic Avenue bridge around 8 PM.

spot.name: Deck 84
spot.image: G:/Shared drives/GVC - Marketing/02 - Assets/Emails/Delray Drip Campaign/Delray Photos/Delray Photos- Horizontal/Atlantic AVe Draw Bridge Intercoastal.png
spot.desc: A waterfront classic beside the Atlantic Avenue bridge, where locals gather year-round and especially in November. Fresh seafood, a relaxed deck on the Intracoastal and dock space for those arriving by boat.

cta.text: Celebrate connection, community and coastal living. Explore your Delray home today.

feature.heading: 🎨 You’re Invited: Art Basel Comes to Boca
feature.image: G:/Shared drives/GVC - Florida/New Development/3 - Le Reve/2 - Marketing Assets/8 - Events/Art Basel 2026-12-07/Deliverables/Postcard/Postcard Horizontal.png
feature.alt: Art Basel Comes to Boca. Monday, December 7th, 2:00 to 7:00 PM, Le Rêve Residences, 200 East Boca Raton Road, Boca Raton. Curated by Galerie Perahia and Galerie Duret. RSVP required.
text: A short drive south of Delray, we’re bringing Art Basel week to Boca Raton. Join us on Monday, December 7th, from 2:00 to 7:00 PM for an afternoon of contemporary art curated by Galerie Perahia and Galerie Duret of Paris, shown inside Le Rêve Residences, a new collection of luxury townhomes at 200 East Boca Raton Road.
View the works, tour the residences and meet the team. Space is limited and an RSVP is required.
